Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer :
01. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in Construction Works as Prime Contractor shall be
5(Five) years.
02. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor of at least 01 (One) number of simillar type work completed within the
last 3 (Three) years with a value of at least Tk 2.50 Lakh under a single contract with Government Organization .
03. The required average annual Construction Turnover shall be greater than Tk 15.00 (Fifteen lakh) Lakh over the last 05 (Five)
years in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Organization of Bangladesh. A summary sheet of last five years Turnover to
submitted with all supporting documents.
04. The minimum Amount of free fund (liquid assets) i.e working capitals or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 3.00 Lakh
.Certificate of unconditional Liquid Asset must be in the form of letter of commitment of Bank for line of credit to the Tenderer in
favour of the work in ePW2a form, otherwise the tender will be summarily rejected. For credit facilities of the Tenderer available
balance of facilities shall be mention.
05. The Tenderer have to up-to-date up-to-date Trade License & Income Tax Clearance Certificate, VAT Registration Certificate of
his own, ABC Contractor & Electrical Supervisory License from Electrical Licensing Board.
06. Minimum Tender Capacity shall be Tk. 2.50 Lakh . The Tenderer must submit Tender Capacity Calculation sheet with
supporting documents.
07.The tenderer must comply with eligibility and qualification criteria mentioned in details in the tender data sheet and particular
conditions of contracts (section 2,4 in the document tab)
8. Manufacturer authorization is required for necessary item.
